Name: Flower Dance Tradition
Author: xyariaa
Description:
[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/51623/51623-1788350939-1230458301.png[/img]
The Flower Dance is a beautiful festival, don't you think?
But really, many of us simply never go there anymore after the first year – or even the first playthrough.
It really just sounds like a little town traditional festival, one where people go because they have to, or because "that's just how it is".

Well, this mod attempts to make this feeling [i]even stronger[/i] while giving you a reason to go back and dance (one that is not "earning a heart with someone").

[center][size=5]For a Happy* Marriage![/size][/center]
[left][/left]
With this mod installed, bachelors and bachelorettes will simply refuse to marry you as long as you have not partnered up during the Flower Dance. Everyone has their own reason for following this tradition, some sillier than others~
[left][/left]
Once you are dating, dance with them during the festival, and they will happily marry you!
[size=2]* does not guarantee a happy marriage[/size]
[left][/left]
[center][size=5]Features[/size][/center]
[left][/left]
[left][list]
[*]Content Pack for [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/45772]Spouses Have Standards[/url][/*]
[*]Wedding proposal blocked until the romanceable wasn't danced with [b]while dating[/b][/*]
[*]Unique rejection dialogue for all romanceable – with a forward support for Clint and Sandy if you use a mod making them romanceable[/*]
[*]Small event introducing you to the tradition, as well as modified letters to mention it[/*]
[*]You [b]don't[/b] need to propose [i]during [/i]the flower dance day, you just need to have danced with them at one point before proposing[/*]
[*]Configuration available to make the dating status not required for the dance to count → use [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]GMCM[/url] for easier configuration[/*]
[*][b]Not retroactive[/b] –  Past dance partner from before the mod was installed will not be known, so you'll need to dance with them again for it to count.[/*]
[*][b]Only for Vanilla NPC[/b] – Modded NPC simply won't care about this "tradition" and will accept your proposal anyway[/*]
[/list][size=2]Adding support for modded NPC would require asking for permissions since it would depend on who the character is and what they care about, and for something so small I don't think it's worth it. However, you can 100% make a personal edit of this mod to add support for any NPC you want – as long as you don't redistribute it later. You simply need to copy what is in the main file, and replace the NPC name with their internal ID.[/size][/left]
[left][/left]
[left][center][size=5]Installation[/size][/center]
[list]
[*]Download the mod[/*]
[*]Extract the mod[/*]
[*]Place the mod in your Mods folder[/*]
[*]Don't forget requirements![/*]
[/list][/left]
[left][center][size=5]Notes[/size][/center]

Please report any bug you might find, including typos and mistakes in the text.[/left]
